title: Engagement File Trail
brief: A Meridian Advisory client says the cost review in engagement {{eng}} used last year's rates. You need to trace the engagement file to find which data and model versions were used and which other engagements may be affected. You have 12 visit points.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Engagements using the same model this quarter
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: File index for {{eng}} lists all documents with versions.
Data source log records the rate table file used: RT-2025.
evidence.whyItMatters: Source recorded; leads to the version.

evidence.text: Rate table RT-2025 was superseded by RT-2026 on 1 March; {{eng}} ran in April.
evidence.whyItMatters: Current approved data must be used.

evidence.text: Model library holds RT-2025 and RT-2026 side by side; RT-2025 is not marked obsolete.
evidence.whyItMatters: Obsolete documents must be removed or marked.
evidence.missedExplanation: Look for obsolete versions still available.

evidence.text: Data provider delivered RT-2026 on time.
5 other engagements this quarter (EN-3310 to EN-3314) used the same model; 3 show RT-2025 in their source logs; no review started.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check other users of the same data.

evidence.text: Review checklist item 4, "data current", is ticked for {{eng}} with no version noted.
Team lead: "Whoever notices the new table loads it." (note 3)
evidence.whyItMatters: An owner for data updates would make it reliable.

evidence.text: File names use mixed date formats.
Printed copies are on a desk in a locked office.

options: {{eng}} and the 3 other engagements this quarter whose source logs show RT-2025, with a check of the remaining 2
decisions.rationale: The obsolete table and weak review widen the scope.

containment: Inform the affected clients and review the 4 engagements
correction: Recalculate with RT-2026 and reissue reports after peer review
cause: No owner for data updates, obsolete tables left available, and a review tick that does not record the version
corrective: Assign a data owner, archive superseded tables, and require the version on the checklist
effectiveness: Audit source logs of engagements monthly for three months

debriefText.found: You traced the data version and found other affected engagements.
debriefText.missed: A tick on a checklist does not prove the check.
debriefText.falseFinding: Naming style and locked papers are not findings.
